about_the_game:
How quickly can you establish a working colony, mine resources, make them into valuable materials, and escape before your work collapses the planet? Put your skills to the test in this demo of Mine Make Escape.

A basic tutorial helps with getting started, after which two levels challenge putting that knowledge to use. A main objective for each must be completed to complete the level, with two secondary objectives to chase for a perfect run.

DEMO HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Quickly establish a thriving mining colony.

  • Master resource extraction and transformation into valuable materials.

  • Race against planetary collapse to escape.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

  • A helpful tutorial to get you started.

  • Two distinct levels to put your knowledge to the test.

  • Clear main objectives for each level.

  • Optional secondary objectives for players seeking a perfect run.

  • 10+ buildings with functionality to mine, refine, expand, and add utility to the colony

  • 3 base resources

We look forward to your feedback as we continue to develop the game. Download the free demo and see if you have what it takes to Mine Make and Escape. Thank you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics setting

short_description: Scout planets, locate resources, build mining colonies, extract and refine as many resources as possible before the planet collapses, and get enough materials to jump to the next system before the tear in space time catches up. How long can you survive?
